newsitem.title: CROATIA: Dog kills grandmother who spared its life.
newsitem.headline: Dog kills grandmother who spared its life.

text.p: A 66-year-old Croatian woman was killed by her grandson's terrier dog whose life she spared two years ago, the daily Vecernji List said on Tuesday.
Katarina Paunovic of Novska, southeast of Zagreb, was attacked by the four-year old pet without prior warning while sitting on her porch on Sunday morning.
The 80-pound (36 kg) Staffordshire terrier went for her neck, severing an artery and persisting until she showed no signs of life.
Her grandson rushed onto the porch when he heard the commotion but Paunovic was already dead.
Paunovic had spared the dog's life two years ago when it bit its owner -- her grandson. He wanted to put it down immediately but she successfully pleaded for its life.
